name: bloodtithe_collector_your_own_life_loss_is_not_enough
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, each opponent discards a card.' On the opponent's turn its 2/2 attacks seat 0 unblocked: seat 0 loses 2 life, no opponent of seat 0 does. Bloodtithe Collector then enters under seat 0: nothing happens; the opponent keeps its card.
